title: fix(spec): withdraw the offered-but-refused `icon` input from the object.form options repeater
body:
Fixes #13671

## What this changes

`packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts` — the fields repeater's `options` sub-form no longer offers an `icon` text input ("Lucide icon name"). `SelectOptionSchema` is a strict shape that has never declared `icon`, so a Lucide name typed into that input came back as an `unrecognized_keys` refusal at publish: the authoring form taught a key the publish door rejects, and the author found out at the 422.

Resolved on the route triage ruled — **ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, remove leg**: declared = offered converges downward. The repeater now offers `label`, `value`, `color`, `description`, which is exactly `SelectOptionSchema`'s authorable key set minus `visibleWhen` (a CEL predicate, not a repeater text input).

`SelectOptionSchema` in `field.zod.ts` is **untouched**, and so is `description` (declared by PR #13669 under the objectui#6153 inherited ruling).

**Clause-②: no.** No accept/reject behaviour moves. `icon` on a select option was refused before this change and is refused after it; metadata that parses today parses identically. The only thing that changes is what the Studio object designer offers an author.

## The premise, measured (not inherited)

The card named a falsifiable premise and forbade substituting #5016's reading for it, because #5016 measured the **ACTION-param** path while objectui's `SelectOptionMetadata` does declare `icon`. So the FIELD-option face was measured on its own, twice, each pass carrying a live positive control:

| tree | `option.icon` on the field-option render path | control |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `.objectui-sha` pin `d8ec8d6d4f011b11c8eb1e6dbd364ef206711391` (the console this repo ships) | 0 reads | GREEN |
| objectui `origin/main` `67dadd602a3a891666ea1513c5de677140784b6a` | 0 reads | GREEN |

The control is on the very same object shape, in the same pass: `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` declares `const options: SelectOptionMetadata[] = selectField.options` and its `renderOne` badge/dot branch reads `option?.label` (`:1538`) and `option?.color` (`:1545`, `:1546`, `:1567`, `:1568`) — and never `option?.icon`. An earlier pass whose control used only `.color` with a narrow receiver list came back empty on both, which is a broken pattern rather than a reading; it was discarded and the pattern widened until the control hit.

Population and sweep, so the zero is checkable:

- The four field-option widgets (`SelectField`, `MultiSelectField`, `RadioField`, `CheckboxesField`), `LookupField`, `TagsField`, `useCascadingOptions`, `OptionsEmptyState`, the cell-renderer bridge, `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` and `packages/core/src/evaluator/optionRules.ts`: zero `icon` reads. The only `icon` tokens there are a lucide import alias (`Phone as PhoneIcon`), that alias rendered, and a Button `size="icon"` prop.
- Identifier-agnostic sweep of the whole objectui tree: 204 source-level `.icon` reads, **none** in `packages/fields`. Receivers tally as nav items, tones, objects, apps, metrics, buttons, alerts, actions, nodes, sections, tabs, related lists, view switchers and chart legends.
- Bracket access and destructuring passes (`['icon']`, `const { icon } = ...`, `({ icon })`): no field-option reader.
- The single `opt.icon` read in that tree, `packages/components/src/custom/config-field-renderer.tsx:204`, is the **config-panel** vocabulary: `ConfigField.options[].icon` is typed `React.ReactNode` for the `icon-group` control. It is a different option shape, and an authored string cannot reach it.

Declaring `icon` instead would widen the accepted set — Clause-② class, needing a maintainer ruling — so it was deliberately not taken. If that ruling ever arrives, the new pin section inverts rather than being deleted.

## The #13669 pin moved in the same stroke

`packages/spec/src/data/field-rows-option-description.test.ts` pinned `icon` as the "still refused" control beside the `description` declaration. That pin asserted **one** side of an offer-vs-door pair, which is exactly how the gap stayed green while the form went on offering the key. It is rewritten, not deleted, and the subject change is written out above the new section:

- section 2's `icon` case is kept and its comment corrected — the door still refuses `icon`, unchanged;
- a new section 3 asserts the **offer** side: the repeater does not offer `icon`; it still offers the four survivors in order (the positive control — an emptied list would satisfy a bare "does not contain icon"); every input it offers names a key the door accepts, asserted through the door's own behaviour rather than a hand-copied list; and the object form declares exactly one `icon` input in total, the OBJECT-level row in Basics, which is a different subject and stays.

An absent sub-form `fields` list is asserted to be a failure, not a narrower offer — the #11410 lesson: with no explicit list the metadata-admin renderer falls through to the derived JSON Schema source.

## Verification

Head at which every reading in THIS section was taken: **`f95dc728`**. The patch round below re-takes the whole gate union at the final head **`4663ba209`**.

Reverse verification (fix committed first, mutation proven on disk, restore proven by hash):

- mutation leg: the `icon` row re-inserted; injected-marker count 1, blob `38249da9` vs HEAD blob `32ffb1f4`;
- result: the 4 new section-3 cases go RED, and **section 2's door case stays GREEN** — a direct demonstration of why the single-half pin could not see the disagreement;
- restore leg: `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`, hash back to `32ffb1f4`, `git diff HEAD` 0 lines, porcelain empty, residual marker count 0. Guarded by an `EXIT INT TERM` trap using absolute paths.

No build/dist leg applies: the pins import `./object.form` as source, so vitest compiles `src` and no `dist` marker can go stale under them.

Commands and their own verdict lines:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` — VERDICT command-exit 0 (run through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`)
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` — `Test Files 450 passed (450)`, `Tests 12072 passed (12072)`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` — exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK — @objectstack/spec's test layer compiles under packages/spec/tsconfig.test.json`. Both edited files confirmed present in a tsc program via `--listFiles` (`object.form.ts` in `tsconfig.json`, the pin test in `tsconfig.test.json`) rather than assumed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` — `✓ All 15 generated artifacts are up to date.` Nothing needed regenerating: `check:authorable-surface`, `check:api-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:liveness` and the rest are green as-is, which follows from no schema key having moved.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:objectui-pin-citations` — `✅ 8 asserting objectui pin citation(s) match .objectui-sha (d8ec8d6d4), 15 historical citation(s) recorded` (13 before this branch: both new read-point records are in the gate's population, written in its HISTORICAL spelling because that is what they are).
- Spec source audits, all exit 0: `check:llms-txt`, `check:yaml-examples`, `check:variant-docs`, `check:empty-state`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:browser-reachable-entries`, `check:exported-any`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:liveness`.
- Repo gates, all exit 0: `check:nul-bytes`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:published-files`, `check:merge-driver`, `docs-audit/check-affected-docs`, `docs-audit/check-drift-comment`, `pm/check-half-states`.
- `scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs` — exit **3**, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: it grades a saved `turbo run test` log that only CI produces. Recorded as NOT MEASURED, which its own text says is neither a red nor a finding.

Gate family re-derived at `f95dc728` with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (no paths — it reads the merge-base change set itself): 53 commands over 3 paths, byte-identical to the derivation taken before the last two commits, so nothing was added late.

**Lint, narrowed and declared.** Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run and was not taken here. The narrowing is measured, not assumed: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the diff returns 3 results, 0 errors, and its only message is the changeset `.md` reporting "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied" — so eslint's own configuration puts the population of this diff at the 2 TypeScript files, both clean. The narrowing cannot hide a verdict on an untouched file because this repo runs one `eslint.config.mjs` that **never enables type-aware linting** for any file (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules) — stated and positively controlled in that config's own header at `:328`.

## Patch round — `check:i18n` (head `4663ba209`)

CI went red on this branch at `f95dc728` in `Type Check · consumer gates`, step `pnpm check:i18n`: `platform-objects  DRIFTED (4)`. The `platform-objects` translation bundles are extracted from the `*.form.ts` leaves, so withdrawing the options sub-form `icon` row left four locale bundles carrying a `fields.options.icon` entry the form no longer declares.

**The deviation, stated plainly:** `pnpm check:i18n` was already in the owed local union — re-deriving the ORIGINAL three-path change set today still lists it, at position 38 of 53. It was derived and not run, so the miss was in the running, not the derivation; CI caught it, which is the backstop working as designed rather than a gate family nobody could have known about.

Fix: `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, committing only the regenerated bundles. Merge mode keeps existing translations and the `en` bundle is rewritten from source; the diff is **removal only** — 4 files, 16 deletions, 0 insertions, one `fields.options.icon` entry (its `label` and its `helpText`) dropped from each of `en`, `es-ES`, `ja-JP`, `zh-CN`. No key was added and no other package's bundles moved.

Readings, taken at the final commit `4663ba209`:

- Red reproduced FIRST, before the fix: `platform-objects  DRIFTED (4)`, `check-i18n-bundles: 1 bundle problem(s)`, exit 1 — with the gate's build prerequisite cleared beforehand (it names its own closure, and it was run), so this is a content verdict and not the unbuilt-CLI shape that gate's header warns reads identically.
- `pnpm check:i18n` — `check-i18n-bundles: OK (9 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)`, `platform-objects  in sync (11 bundle(s))`, exit 0.
- `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill` — exit 0. This is the one family the four bundle files ADD to the union; everything else the patch owes was owed already.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck` — exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` — `Test Files 33 passed (33)`, `Tests 518 passed (518)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/field-rows-option-description.test.ts` — `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 32 passed (32)`: the section-2 door pin and the section-3 offer pin are both unmoved by the regeneration.
- Full derived union re-run at `4663ba209` with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths — it reads the merge-base change set itself): now **54 commands over 7 paths**. All 54 were executed: 53 exit 0, and `scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs` exit **3** (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, the CI-only log grader) recorded as NOT MEASURED, unchanged from the first round.
- That derivation printed a STALE-TREE warning — this branch is behind `origin/main` and two family-deriving scripts moved across the range. Rather than assume it immaterial, the same seven paths were re-derived in a worktree checked out at `origin/main` `72adb7fcb`: the command list is byte-identical, so the staleness changes nothing about what this PR owes. The branch was not rebased or merged to obtain that.

## Not done here, on purpose

Draft, base `main`. Not flipped ready, not queued, no auto-merge armed. `needs:contract-review` is hung on this PR and on the card because the path limb (`packages/spec/src/**`) trips, while the content limb does not — see the Clause-② declaration above.

**Out-of-scope finding filed, not fixed here: #14327.** The #3786 metadata form ↔ Zod reconciliation — the gate whose stated rule is that a form offering a key the Zod does not accept is *always* a defect — walks only ONE level of nested form lists, so the `options` repeater (and five other depth-2 lists, measured) is outside its population entirely. That is the structural reason this card's disagreement survived a green gate, and it is why the new section 3 above is a per-instance pin rather than the class fix. Deliberately not ridden on this PR: this diff is a ruled single-key removal with `Clause-②: no`, and a gate change would add an unrelated failure surface to it.
